has_behavior_change.instructions: Does this change alter runtime behavior, business logic, or observable output (not comments or formatting only)?

criteria.true: Observable behavior or logic was changed

has_no_test_update.instructions: Given the behavior change visible here, are there no corresponding test file changes in the provided context?

criteria.true: Behavior changed but no test updates are present in context
criteria.false: Test updates appear present or no behavior change

has_no_test_file.instructions: Does this module or feature area appear to have no test file at all in the provided context?

criteria.true: No test file is evident for this area
criteria.false: A test file appears to exist

touches_public_api_without_test.instructions: Does this change modify a public API, export, or contract without any test changes in the provided context?

criteria.true: Public API changed without test changes in context
criteria.false: No untested public API change evident

has_edge_case_untested.instructions: Does this change add new branches, error paths, or edge cases that appear untested in the provided context?

criteria.true: New branches or edge cases appear untested
criteria.false: No untested edge cases worth flagging
